benchmark.cache_policy: buffered after generation; OS cache not evicted; NOT a cold-device benchmark
benchmark.device_type: not independently established; no physical-HDD claim
benchmark.nonce_policy: deterministic fixtures for reproduction; no unpredictable live challenge claim
benchmark.physical_io_energy_wear: not measured; OS block counters are observations, not disk-byte evidence
benchmark.security_limit: public deterministic seed and Merkle metadata permit on-demand regeneration

simulation.limitation: No conversion of MiB or measured latency into accepted units; no prices or economic viability inferred.
